open_evidence: https://web.archive.org/web/20220331051516/https://www.smokysclub.com/ - archived official site (Mar 31, 2022) shows hours 'CLOSED' and a farewell notice after 69 years; https://spectrumnews1.com/wi/milwaukee/news/2022/02/21/landmark-supper-club-closes-after-69-years - Feb 21, 2022 article: closing with 'less than two weeks to go'; smokysclub.com no longer resolves (Sept 2026)
closed_reason: Permanently closed in early March 2022 after 69 years; the Schmock family decided to close after the pandemic (Spectrum News 1, Feb 21, 2022: https://spectrumnews1.com/wi/milwaukee/news/2022/02/21/landmark-supper-club-closes-after-69-years; farewell notice on the archived official site, Mar 31, 2022: https://web.archive.org/web/20220331051516/https://www.smokysclub.com/).
notes: Official About text (archived 2022): founded 1953 by Leonard 'Smoky' Schmock and wife Janet, who bought a supper club named Hogan's on University Ave; moved in 1969 a few doors down to 3005 University Ave, the former Justo's Supper Club; later owned by sons Larry and Tom. Farewell notice says grandsons Matt and Tim were taking much of Smoky's to Mount Horeb to open Driftless Social (128 E Main St, Mount Horeb - site live Sept 2026, not a Smoky's reopening). Exact last night not confirmed (article said less than two weeks away as of Feb 21, 2022). What now occupies 3005 University Ave was not found; Overture still carries stale Smoky's/'Len Jan Ltd' records there.
